description: NOT for webhook debugging. Call it only when the user asks about pricing, plan limits, or upgrading, or hits a cap error. No inputs. Returns the live plan catalog: every plan with its limits including local and external auto-forward slots, monthly and yearly subscription pricing, short-term day passes, currentPlanTierId when known, upgradeUrl, and a humanAction pointing at the billing page. It is the same source of truth the pricing page uses, so compare their current plan against the alternatives and name the concrete differences and prices. Buying is human-only: relay the humanAction link and wait.
name: get_upgrade_options
title: Get upgrade options
